title: Major Breaking Changes: Data Governance Features Removed
summary: The Dataplex API has undergone significant breaking changes, with the complete removal of `DataAttributeBinding` and `DataTaxonomy` resources, along with all their associated methods and schemas. Developers using these data governance features must update their integrations.
details: This update introduces substantial breaking changes to the Dataplex API. The entire `projects.locations.dataAttributeBindings` and `projects.locations.dataTaxonomies` resource collections, including all their `create`, `get`, `list`, `patch`, and `delete` methods, have been removed. Consequently, related schemas such as `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataAttribute`, `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataAttributeBinding`, `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataTaxonomy`, and their corresponding list response objects are no longer available. Additionally, the `state` property within `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataAssetAccessGroupConfig` has been made read-only, meaning it can no longer be set by API calls. Developers relying on these removed data governance features will need to refactor their code. A minor addition includes the new `defaultIamRoleConfig` property in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataProductAccessGroup`, which allows for configuring default IAM roles on data assets.
